newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - CBA restructures Singapore operation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - CBA restructures Singapore operation.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Wednesday that clients of traded financial markets products currently serviced through Singapore would now be handled by the Sydney head office.

"The focus of our Singapore operation will shift from volume traded products to corporate finance activity, with we believe, key opportunities in infrastructure and project finance," Paul Riordan, CBA's financial markets head of global trading.
The CBA statement did not say if staff numbers in Singapore had been reduced and bank officials were unavailable for comment. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
